# Telegram Network Diagnostics Project

## Project Overview
Python CLI tool for diagnosing and monitoring Telegram Bot API network connections.

## Development Guidelines
- Use type hints for all functions
- Follow PEP 8 style guide
- Use pnpm for package management if needed
- Keep dependencies minimal

## Project Structure
- `telegram_diagnostics/` - main package
- CLI commands: check, monitor, full
- Dependencies: aiohttp, Pillow

## Best Practices
- Avoid using `any` type
- Write readable code with meaningful comments only for complex logic
- Maintain consistency with existing code patterns
